user.title: Connect to Smart Heating Controller
user.description: Enter the IP address and port of your ESP32 Smart Heating Controller.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the controller. Check IP address and ensure device is online.
error.invalid_response: Received invalid response from the controller.

abort.already_configured: This Smart Heating device is already configured.

clear_dtc_history.name: Clear DTC Fault History
clear_dtc_history.description: Purges inactive diagnostic trouble code records while retaining current reboot entry.

clear_window_pause.name: Clear Window Pause
clear_window_pause.description: Clears window pause state on a specific zone or all zones.

set_window_pause.name: Trigger Window Pause
set_window_pause.description: Triggers a temporary heating suspension on a zone (e.g. from a door/window sensor like Sonoff DW2).

set_zone_boost.name: Set Zone Boost
set_zone_boost.description: Applies a temporary temperature boost (0.5 - 2.0°C) above current schedule for a zone.
